d: Pale silver hair with straight bangs and long, wavy lengths framing a youthful, childlike face with wide, light blue eyes. A petite build dressed in a black and gold ornate dress with a red bow at the collar, layered under a red and black cloak with a white fur trim collar and a starry cityscape pattern on the inner lining. The outfit is topped with a tall black top hat featuring gold filigree and a single turquoise feather, while the legs are clad in dark red tights and black pointed shoes. Accessories include a small brown book held in one hand.
